'''Metrisse''' was a [[Fondorian]] [[Music/Legends|composer]] who lived at the [[Poloda Place]] apartment complex on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Shadows" /> by [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' to [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. The novel establishes that Metrisse was at [[Poloda Place]] over twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before, equating to by [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].</ref> While there, he composed the [[Études of Time and Space]], a piece of music that was considered famous<ref name="Shadows" /> by [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> while in Poloda Place, the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] thought about Metrisse and his composition when he recalled the number of artistic individuals who had stayed at the complex due to its low renting prices, large living areas, and perceived security.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Metrisse was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] as the second installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' trilogy.<ref name="Shadows" />
